services.name: Raft Guides
services.desc: Some river days are about the rapids. A great day of rafting at Flaming Gorge in summer is about something better: clear cold water, glowing red canyon walls, and a string of sandy beaches made for pulling over, spreading out lunch, and swimming until you are ready to drift again. The stretch of the Green River below Flaming Gorge Dam is one of the few places in Utah where you can plan an entire float around where you want to stop and cool off. A day of green river rafting here is less about conquering water and more about savoring it, and this guide shows you how to build your Green River day around the best swimming sand bars. services.desc: Welcome to Dutch John Resort, one of the most sought-after green river campgrounds and RV parks near Green River, in Dutch John, Utah offering exceptional camping experiences for every type of outdoor enthusiast. Perfectly located next to stunning Flaming Gorge in the heart of the Ashley National Forest. Our resort blends modern comfort with the raw beauty of nature. Whether you’re planning a weekend getaway or an extended stay, our green river campground provides access to incredible natural features, beautiful views, and endless outdoor recreation opportunities along the Green River in Red Canyon with its surrounding landscapes. At Dutch John Resort, we know every camper is different.

services.name: Fishing Guides
services.desc: Welcome to Dutch John Resort’s comprehensive fishing resource center - your gateway to mastering the legendary waters of Green River and Flaming Gorge, Utah. Whether you’re a seasoned angler or just starting your fishing journey, our collection of expert guides, local insights, and proven techniques will help you make the most of these world-renowned fishing destinations. Fly fishing Utah’s Green River? Learn the 3-hour window that separates good days from epic ones at Dutch John.
